proposals.name: Soil Science & Regenerative Agriculture Enthusiasts
proposals.buyer_persona: Soil scientists, permaculturists, agronomists, and no-dig market gardeners who are obsessed with the soil food web, mycorrhizal fungi, and soil horizons.
product_angles: Humorous and hyper-specific stickers for laptops/water bottles ('Mycorrhizae do it deeper', 'Respect the O-Horizon', 'N-P-K is so 1994')
Soil Sampling Field Logbook on Amazon KDP (structured templates for recording GPS, pH, texture, organic matter, and biology)
Intricate vector designs of soil microbe profiles (tardigrades, nematodes, protozoa) for apparel
proposals.best_pipeline_or_new: produce_lowcontent_kdp (modified for soil logs) & new pipeline 'produce_microbe_vectors'
proposals.first_test_product: The Ultimate Soil Sampling & Biology Field Logbook (Amazon KDP)

proposals.name: Eurorack & Modular Synthesizer Hobbyists
proposals.buyer_persona: Electronic music producers, hardware hackers, and modular synth collectors with high disposable income who spend hours patching cables and custom-building synthesizer racks.
product_angles: Modular Synth Patch Sheets / Logbook on KDP (blank layout templates to visually draw patch cable routing for live performance recall)
Technical/humorous stickers and tees on Redbubble ('Unstable LFO enthusiast', 'Cables are my therapy', 'VCO > Spouse')
SVG Frontplate design templates for DIY Eurorack modules
proposals.first_test_product: Eurorack Modular Synth Patch Ledger & Recall Sheet Book (Amazon KDP)

proposals.name: French GR (Grande Randonnée) Trail Finishers
proposals.buyer_persona: Hikers and trail runners who have completed or plan to hike specific French long-distance trails (GR20 Corsica, GR34 Brittany, GR10 Pyrenees) wanting to show off their achievement.
product_angles: Minimalist altitude-profile elevation charts of specific GRs as poster prints or mugs
Hike Completion Passports & Trail Journals on KDP specifically tailored to the French GR rules and refuges
Stickers with trail-specific inside jokes ('I survived the Cirque de la Solitude - GR20', 'GR34: Mud, Wind and Galettes')
proposals.first_test_product: Carnet de Randonnée - Journal de Bord du GR34 (Amazon KDP)

proposals.name: Retro PS1-Style Indie Game Developers
proposals.buyer_persona: Solo indie game developers building retro-horror, sci-fi, or low-poly games for platforms like itch.io, seeking authentic 90s console aesthetics without making assets from scratch.
product_angles: Low-poly 3D models of retro computer terminals, crates, and CRT monitors optimized for Cults3D/itch.io (can be exported via basic Blender scripting)
Tileable retro texture packs (64x64, 128x128 pixels) generated via AI image downscaling pipelines
Notion Solo Dev Game Production Planner customized for retro projects
proposals.first_test_product: PSX-Era Low-Poly Sci-Fi Lab Prop Pack (Cults3D / itch.io)

proposals.name: Traditional Archery & Bowyers (Bow-Makers)
proposals.buyer_persona: Hobbyists who build their own wooden selfbows (flatbows, longbows) from staves, rejecting modern compound bows, obsessed with wood grain, draw weight, and traditional craftsmanship.
product_angles: Bowyer's Logbook on KDP to track wood drying, tillering progress, draw weight curves, and wood species details
Redbubble designs focused on tillering physics, wood grain aesthetics, and historical bows ('Tillering: The art of bending wood without crying')
SVG vector packs of traditional archery target designs and vintage quiver patterns
proposals.first_test_product: The Bowyer's Workshop Logbook: Tillering & Build Tracker (Amazon KDP)

proposals.name: MRI Technologists & Radiographers
proposals.buyer_persona: Medical imaging professionals who operate MRI scanners or X-ray machines, looking for niche humor regarding safety zones, claustrophobic patients, and helium quench procedures.
product_angles: Stickers for badge reels, clipboards, and water bottles ('MRI Safe... mostly', 'I spin protons for a living', 'Keep Calm and Watch the Quench')
Shift planner and CEU (Continuing Education Unit) tracker notebook on Amazon KDP
Minimalist line-art anatomy designs combined with scanner magnetic field lines
proposals.first_test_product: MRI Tech Shift & CEU Logbook (Amazon KDP)
